title: RepoHone rule candidate
description: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN Phase 2. A developer's explicit 'this is a project rule' statement, bound to the exact session it came from. Created locally with no model call; carries analysis consent for itself only and never authorizes changing the project (ARCHITECTURE 1.2).

checkout_id.description: The checkout this was marked in. Required, never inferred: a candidate that floats free of its checkout could be attributed to another worktree's session.

session_id.description: The exact session the statement was made in. Resolved against this checkout's records, so a session belonging to another checkout does not match.

state.description: A candidate is never a rule. It is what the developer said, awaiting analysis it has already consented to.

corrective_turn.description: Which turn holds the correction, when the developer names it. Null means unidentified, never inferred from adjacency: authentic validation is unavailable rather than wrong (ARCHITECTURE 14).

evidence_refs.description: Pointers, not copies. The candidate records which captured evidence was resolved, so analysis re-reads it from the snapshot rather than from a stored transcript.

estimated_tokens.description: Bytes of model input, not provider tokens. The v1 field name predates the correction; a token is at least one byte, so the value is always under ARCHITECTURE 12's token maximum.

authorizes_apply.description: ARCHITECTURE 1.2 — analysis consent is not application consent.
